title: Projection onto a rotated subspace: P_{gV} = g P_V g* and dim gV = dim V (fact F1)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), and g ∈ E →L[ℝ] E with g*g = 1, where g* is the adjoint. Let V ⊆ E be a linear subspace and gV := g(V) its image (Submodule.map). Then the orthogonal projection onto gV is g ∘ P_V ∘ g*, where P_W := W.starProjection; that is, P_{gV} = g P_V g* in E →L[ℝ] E. Moreover dim gV = dim V.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1 → ∀ V : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), (V.map (g : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N)).starProjection = g * V.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g ∧ finrank ℝ (V.map (g : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N)) = finrank ℝ V
